CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE

   B. Say Background to Monarchy in Israel King Saul has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Background to Monarchy in Israel King Saul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Background to Monarchy in Israel King Saul.
